title: Related entities
description: A domain-neutral relationship-shape pattern: every concept tagged 'primary' must be connected by a relationship to a concept tagged 'related'. Demonstrates obligations over relationship structure, not just concept presence.

roles.title: Primary entity
roles.description: An entity that must be related to a supporting concept.

roles.title: Related entity
roles.description: The concept a primary must be linked to.

obligations.title: Primary concepts are linked to a related concept
